# std/make

> Make a slice of n zeroed elements: make([T], n)

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/make.pkg) · translated by [bintables/make](../bintables/make.md) · translated by [ctables/make](../ctables/make.md) · translated by [webtables/make](../webtables/make.md)

```
let squares = make([int], 10)
for i = 0 to 9
  squares[i] = i * i
end
print len(squares)    // 10
```

A negative length stops the program with
`panic: negative length in make`.
